title: E2E — Trade Brief · 03 Jun 2026
catalyst: Monetisation of E2E's newly-live NVIDIA Blackwell (B200) GPU fleet against ₹265 cr of IndiaAI Mission LLM-training orders — the Q1 FY27 print (~Aug 2026) is the first clean test of whether utilisation scaling to 80–90% swings the company back to profit and validates the move to fresh 52-week highs.
